messages:
Maria Chen: FYI starting schema switchover for tenant_shards in 5m (03:45 UTC). migration id 2026-03-20-tenant-shards. brief exclusive lock on events expected (~30s).
Kevin Patel: oncall preflight ok, running secondary smoke now. will watch replica lag.
DeployBot: deploy initiated: deploybot/ship v2.3.4 -> canary A. job=3501234567-canary.
Samir O'Neill: quick note on backfill: doing incremental rows-only backfill after DDL, estimated 18-25m if throttled. recommend batch=250, sleep=15ms.
Dana Ruiz: add pin: service-api -> v2.3.4 for 10m after migration. rollback plan in runbook: drop new partitions + resume old writes.
Maria Chen: agreed. abort criteria: lock > 60s OR replica_lag > 30s. abort command: /deploybot rollback --job 3501234567
Kevin Patel: smoke fail: replica lag jumped to 60s on replica-2, pausing deploy. setting holdpoint.
DeployBot: canary paused: holdpoint triggered (metric: replica_lag>30s). canary health: degraded.
Samir O'Neill: I'll open a quiesce for writes to shard-14 and run a small consistency check on the prebackfill set. toggling feature flag shard-14:read_only.
Dana Ruiz: runbook snippet for forced backfill (for reference): ```pg_backfill --shard=14 --mode=incremental --batch=250 --sleep-ms=15 --safe-check```
Maria Chen: run lightweight prefix-check: verify latest 10k PKs, if checksum mismatch abort.
Kevin Patel: replicaset recovery in progress, tail lag dropping to 12s, holding for 2 mins before resume.
DeployBot: runbackfill: job 8812 queued (depends on deploy job 3501234567). throttles=0.2 rps.
Samir O'Neill: backfill job 8812 started. CPU ~45%, rows/sec ~1.2k, errors=0 so far.
Maria Chen: monitoring KV cache and db locks, no long locks reported. good to proceed with canary resume.
Kevin Patel: canary resumed, running validation probes.
DeployBot: canary complete: success criteria met (latency within 5ms baseline, errors <0.1%). scheduling full roll in 3m.
Dana Ruiz: release note draft: "DB migration 2026-03-20: add tenant_shard partitioning + incremental backfill. Rollback: drop partition and revert routing. Expected brief lock during switchover"
Maria Chen: final check: keep pin for 10m, unpin after 11m. If any regression, rollback immediately.
Kevin Patel: unpin scheduled at +11m. :thumbsup:
DeployBot: full deploy complete. jobs: canary=success, rollout=success. metrics: p95 +4ms, errors 0.02%.
Maria Chen: merging release notes and closing thread. thanks all :party_face:
